paper.title_en: Extended strange metal and superconductivity in partially filled moiré Hubbard bands
paper.abstract_en: Moiré semiconductors provide a physical realization of the Hubbard model. Bandwidth-tuned Mott transitions and complex phase diagrams mimicking those of high-temperature superconductors have been demonstrated near a weak Mott insulating state at half-band-filling. The platform also provides an opportunity to explore the physics of a partially filled Hubbard band at doping densities far away from the Mott insulator, a regime that has remained largely unexplored. Here we report the emergence of an extended strange metal (ESM), in both doping density and twist angle, in a partially filled Hubbard band of twisted bilayer WSe2. The ESM is in the clean limit, persists down to 100mK, and spans over multiple symmetry-breaking ground states; it also appears only at small twist angles, where electronic correlations are strong. These observations distinguish the state from the reported strange metals associated with quantum criticality and favor the viewpoint that it is an intrinsic state of matter. We also report the observation of a new superconducting dome being developed from the ESM but far away from both the Mott insulating state and the van Hove singularity of the material. Our work opens the door to exploring the new regime of partially filled Hubbard bands in the clean limit.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在扭曲双层WSe2部分填充Hubbard带中报道了扩展奇异金属与远离Mott绝缘体及van Hove奇点的新超导穹顶，直接关联奇异金属这一凝聚态全息核心议题；实验清晰、结论新颖，值得点击阅读以评估其对奇异金属本质讨论的意义。
decision.title_zh: 部分填充莫尔Hubbard带中的扩展奇异金属与超导
decision.abstract_zh: 莫尔半导体为Hubbard模型提供了物理实现。在半带填充的弱Mott绝缘态附近，已展示出带宽调控的Mott转变以及模仿高温超导体的复杂相图。该平台还提供了探索远离Mott绝缘体的掺杂密度下部分填充Hubbard带物理的机会，这一区域在很大程度上仍未被探索。在此，我们报道在扭曲双层WSe2的部分填充Hubbard带中，在掺杂密度和扭转角两方面均出现扩展奇异金属（ESM）。该ESM处于干净极限，持续到100mK，并跨越多个对称破缺基态；它也只在小扭转角下出现，此时电子关联很强。这些观察将该态与已报道的与量子临界性相关的奇异金属区分开来，并支持它是物质本征态的观点。我们还报道观察到由该ESM发展出的新超导穹顶，但它远离该材料的Mott绝缘态和van Hove奇点。我们的工作为在干净极限下探索部分填充Hubbard带的新区域打开了大门。
